title: More equipment
description: This mod adds more armor and equipment.
body:
More Armor Modrinth Description

A NeoForge mod designed to expand Minecraft's equipment system, adding a variety of powerful swords, unique armor sets, functional blocks, and special items. All armor pieces come with permanent passive bonuses that activate when worn, significantly enriching your gameplay experience!

🛡️ Core Features

1. Armor Sets with Permanent Bonuses

Each armor piece grants a permanent passive effect when worn, which automatically deactivates when the piece is removed:

2. Powerful Swords

A range of swords from fun basic options to top-tier weapons, each with unique attributes:

- Dirt Sword: A fun basic sword with 150 durability, mining level equivalent to stone tools

- Redstone Sword / Super Redstone Sword: High-durability redstone-based weapons with significantly increased damage and attack speed

- Emerald Sword / Super Emerald Sword: Powerful weapons forged from emeralds with better enchantability

- Enderite Sword: Ultra-high durability (6480) + 8 damage points, with excellent attack speed

- Death Sword: Extreme damage output (12 damage points), with lower enchantability but maximum combat power

3. Functional Blocks

- Enderite Ore: A high-hardness ore (hardness 20.0), requires corresponding tools to mine

- Enderite Block: A metallic block with high explosion resistance (blast resistance 28.0), suitable for building and decoration

4. Special Items

- Hardened Redstone: The core crafting material for the Redstone Armor set

- Enderite Ingot: The material used to craft Enderite armor, weapons, and blocks

📥 Installation

1. Install the latest version of NeoForge for your Minecraft version

2. Download the mod file from Modrinth

3. Place the mod file in your Minecraft mods folder

4. Launch the game and enjoy!

⚙️ Configuration

You can adjust mod settings through the Config.java file (or in-game config menu if available), including:

- Enabling/disabling specific armor bonuses

- Adjusting the durability and damage values of weapons

- Tweaking the spawn rate of Enderite Ore

🔧 Compatibility

- Minecraft Version: 1.20.x (check the mod page for specific compatible versions)

- Mod Loader: NeoForge (Forge is not supported)

- Compatible with most vanilla-friendly mods, avoid using with other armor-overhaul mods to prevent conflicts

🐛 Feedback & Support

If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for new features, feel free to:

- Leave a comment on the Modrinth page

- Create an issue on the mod's GitHub repository (link available on the Modrinth page)

- Contact the mod developer through the provided social media links
